title: POST customers request: resolve or create, link the WordPress user id, apply consent, or redeem a portal sign-in ticket or an OAuth access token
description: Consent true only lifts Do_Not_Contact; false never touches Blocked; null leaves the status alone. Idempotent per organisation + phone. With verified_via sso_ticket the ticket identifies the customer, so phone and phone_country are omitted; the ticket is used up whatever the outcome (410 ticket_invalid when unknown, expired, used or minted for another outlet). With verified_via oauth the access token identifies the customer the same way (no phone, no ticket): it must be unexpired, unrevoked, issued to this outlet's OAuth client with the store:link scope, for a customer of the outlet's organisation; it is revoked whatever the outcome (410 oauth_token_invalid when it is not usable).

external_id.description: WordPress user id as a string; null for guests.

sso_state.description: The state the store kept in its cookie when the shopper pressed its sign-in button (store-sign-in.query.json). Required when the ticket was minted for that button, ignored otherwise; a ticket bound to a state is refused (410 ticket_invalid, and used up) when this is missing or does not match.
